breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² with K=2.0 fully applied in the denominator, computing (KL)² = (2.0×1000)² = 4×10⁶. It does not repeat the erroneous instruction that K affects only the mode shape. The final result (~592,176 N ≈ 592.2 kN) matches what the ground truth formula would produce, confirming the inconsistency was resolved.
